versions.content: Service Name Fr If_ Disable Absolute Timer IRQ Syntax Std_ Return Type Fr If_ Disable Absolute Timer IRQ ( uint8 Fr If_ Ctrl Idx, uint8 Fr If_ Abs Timer Idx ) Service ID [hex] 0x23 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy non reentrant for the same Flex Ray CC, reentrant for different Flex Ray CCs Parameters (in) Fr If_ Ctrl Idx Index of the Flex Ray CC to address. Fr If_ Abs Timer Idx Index of the absolute timer to address. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return Type E_ OK: The call of the Flex Ray Driver's API service has returned E_ OK. E_ NOT_ OK: The call of the Flex Ray Driver's API service has returned E_ NOT_ OK, or an error has been detected in development mode. Description Wraps the Flex Ray Driver API function Fr_ Disable Absolute Timer IRQ(). Available via Fr If.h
